MKI · Jellyfin plugin

Guest Pass

Temporary guest accounts from a link, a QR code or a code. Guests see only the libraries you pick, have no password, and their accounts lock and delete themselves when the pass ends.

What guests can and can't do

The same for every pass. Only the limits above change.

Can

  • check_circleWatch the libraries of their pass, up to the rating you set
  • check_circleKeep their own Continue Watching and favourites until the end
  • check_circleSign in a TV with Quick Connect, which counts as one of their devices
  • check_circleWatch from outside your home network, if the pass allows it

Can't

  • cancelSee your other users, libraries or any admin page
  • cancelPlay or open anything outside their libraries and rating, even by its address
  • cancelRead your server's settings, folders or network setup
  • cancelDownload, delete, edit or share anything, make playlists, or use Live TV and SyncPlay
  • cancelRequest titles through Seerr or start library scans
  • cancelSign in with a password: guest accounts have none
  • cancelKeep watching after the end, on any device: every device is signed out

Guest accounts

What happens at the end of a pass.

At the end, guests are signed out everywhere and locked. Their accounts and watch history are deleted after this many days, so you can still extend a pass. 0 to 30; 0 deletes them within a minute.
days
Guests get a message in their open apps, and the badge in the web client turns orange. 0 to 24 hours; 0 = no warning.
hours
Jellyfin plays a video or song to anyone who has its address, without signing in. On, playing needs a signed-in account or an API key, so a guest whose pass ended cannot keep playing titles they saw. Apps sign in anyway; DLNA players cannot.

shield

How guests are kept in their lane

Always on, nothing to set.

  • keyUnguessable links. A link holds 256 random bits and a code 8 characters. The plugin keeps only a keyed fingerprint of each, so not even its own files can be used to join. A new link replaces both at once.
  • speedRate limits. Wrong codes are counted per address and for the whole server; after too many, code entry pauses for 15 minutes. Behind a reverse proxy, add it under Dashboard → Networking → Known proxies so each visitor's own address counts.
  • person_offMinimal accounts. No password, hidden from the sign-in list, never an administrator, only the pass's libraries, no downloads, deleting or settings. Requests a guest may not make are refused before Jellyfin sees them, and a guest plays only titles of their pass, only while it lasts.
  • lock_clockA hard end. Playback stops, every device and TV is signed out and the account is locked, then deleted. Whenever Jellyfin stops or the plugin is turned off, all guests are locked until it runs again; uninstalling it deletes them.
  • tvTVs. Guests sign in TVs with Jellyfin's Quick Connect, only from a device they already joined on, and only up to their device limit.
